Container.Name: menagerie
Container.Overview: Local model management and inference. Set the dashboard address to this server's trusted private IPv4 address. The dashboard has no login or TLS. Inference remains loopback-only; host-network clients can use the local gateway. Persistent models, engines and configuration belong in /data. CPU works without GPU passthrough. NVIDIA acceleration requires the host NVIDIA driver/container integration and explicit GPU passthrough. This version is privately distributed; registry access is required. Actual Unraid hardware acceptance is pending.

Config.Name: Persistent application data
Config.Description: Configuration, downloaded models, engines and cache. Must be writable by UID 99 / GID 100. Existing external model libraries can be mapped read-only separately.

Config.Name: Dashboard private IPv4 address
Config.Description: Enter this server's private LAN IPv4 address. Trusted LAN administration only; no login or TLS. Leaving empty binds only loopback.

Config.Name: NVIDIA driver capabilities
Config.Description: Used only with NVIDIA GPU passthrough. Includes nvidia-smi telemetry when supplied by the host runtime.
